usage: 鮑魚 is used as a noun to refer to the marine shellfish, abalone, commonly found in seafood menus.
You can use 鮑魚 in sentences to talk about ordering or eating abalone dishes.
When describing how something tastes or looks, 鮑魚 can be the subject or object of your sentence.
鮑魚 often appears in compound phrases with cooking methods or dishes, like '蒸鮑魚' (steamed abalone).
